page.content:
Senou (瀬能 Senō) is a minor character from Street Fighter II: The Animated Movie. He is a fighter that is easily defeated by Ryu with a single hit. After seeing the match, Fei Long decides to challenge Ryu.

page.overview:
Who is Senou?

Senou (瀬能 Senō) is a minor character from Street Fighter II: The Animated Movie. He is a fighter that is easily defeated by Ryu with a single hit. After seeing the match, Fei Long decides to challenge Ryu.
